name_reason: Name already conforms to convention: data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> with battle-core prefix (data_fd2_battle_). 'summon_anim_variant_b' is a meaningful variant identifier (one of the summon-spell animation handlers A/B/D/E + main + minor), not an address residue; 'terminate_flag' correctly reflects both the boolean data type and the purpose (latch that suppresses color rotation when the animation winds down). No hex/address residue suffix. Consistent with siblings data_fd2_battle_summon_anim_variant_a_terminate_flag (0x5401B), _variant_d_terminate_flag (0x540B8), and data_fd2_battle_summon_main_anim_terminate_flag (0x53FE2).
purpose: Single-byte boolean latch that suppresses the frame-7 color-rotation step of the variant-B 6-slot summon-spell animation once the animation is told to wind down.
logic_summary: Owned solely by fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_b_6slot @ 0x26BFD (battle summon-spell dispatch-table entry #5 of 10 at 0x523B9). INIT (state_code 0) clears it to 0 (MOV byte ptr [0x54053],0x0 @ 0x26CB1). state_code 6 sets it to 1 (MOV byte ptr [0x54053],0x1 @ 0x26CD6). During a TICK frame (state_code 2/5/8) it is read byte-wide as the frame-7 rotation guard (MOVZX EAX,byte ptr [0x54053] @ 0x26D48 then TEST/JNZ): when nonzero, the per-slot color-rotation / RNG-jitter restart block is skipped, so the animation stops cycling colors and winds down.
element_semantics: Boolean flag: 0 = animate normally (color rotation enabled at frame 7); 1 = animation terminating (color rotation suppressed). Read via zero-extending MOVZX (unsigned semantics).
notes: Source comment (anisummn.c lines 551-566) is already precise and byte-accurate: it documents all three access sites with addresses matching the live xrefs/disasm (WRITE 0x26CB1, WRITE 0x26CD6, READ 0x26D48), the byte-wide MOVZX access, uint8 type, and zero-bss runtime-state classification -> comment_verdict=keep, no source edit. is_const=false confirmed by two game-side WRITE xrefs from fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_b_6slot. Ghidra PLATE_COMMENT at 0x54053 is consistent with this understanding -> ghidra_plate_action=none. Observed (not modified, out of scope): the data address also carries a stale leftover PRE_COMMENT (older emit-pipeline scaffolding: 'Pool: fd2. Emit: emit_c_global byte = 0.') that duplicates the PLATE; per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism data plates belong in PLATE_COMMENT not PRE_COMMENT, so this PRE comment could be cleaned up in a later non-refine pass. on-disk image = 0x00 (BSS). segment .object2.
